scope: Validation archive, source preservation, harness overlays and focused six-file production diff review; no timings or broad test suite rerun.

browser.reason: Chromium process-singleton socket denied; no browser correctness result

reviewed_invariants: Incremental assumption collections are captured before deferred application; final IntRangeDomain metadata safely avoids integer enumeration.
Adjacent integer bound complement handles Dart2JS representable gaps and rejects native endpoint overflow explicitly.
Compiled geometry metadata is copied; private final AD implementation retains specialized dispatch; shared callbacks/manifolds remain documented boundaries.
CAD parameter/revision metadata and topology obligations are privately captured; initial empty graphs cannot bypass reference validation.
Reference extrusion uses owned profile scalars and retains early invalid-dimension rejection before hole enumeration.
Mesh replacement retains incidence, duplicate, area, volume, insertion order, degree-two and connected-link checks; public point arithmetic is unchanged.

pre_existing_limitations_not_introduced_.finding: A custom-equality Set containing only integers is converted to element-wise AtomEq literals; custom membership equivalence is therefore honored only by the predicate fallback. This behavior predates the patch.
pre_existing_limitations_not_introduced_.counterexample: HashSet<int> using absolute-value equality/hash with {1}, base x in [-1,1] (or base constrained to x=-1): contains(-1) is true but the atomic assumption permits only 1.
pre_existing_limitations_not_introduced_.status: Reported to root and confirmed by independent discrete agent; final documentation must avoid claiming unrestricted custom integer-set membership support.

limitations: Expanded concurrent Dart logs repeat the currently displayed test, so their distinct printed file names are not a complete execution manifest. The 127 native-file count is the frozen default-discovery source inventory; the complete unfiltered command and 1789 successful progress increments agree. Both portable commands explicitly list all 44 files.
Local browser evidence is a pre-test launch failure, not passing browser coverage. No remote CI status was independently queried during this file-focused review.
Audit reconciles saved evidence and current source; it is not an independent repetition of all tests.
